sections.content: Impersonal constructions describe learning processes without naming a specific learner. Spanish commonly uses se, hay que and es necesario to express general statements and conditions for learning.

items.spanish: Se aprende mucho con la práctica.
items.english: A lot is learned through practice.

items.spanish: Hay que concentrarse durante la clase.
items.english: You have to concentrate during the lesson.

items.spanish: Es necesario revisar el material con frecuencia.
items.english: It is necessary to review the material regularly.

sections.content: Use se, hay que and es necesario when the statement applies generally rather than to one named learner.
